response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong web/full-stack, D-language, and testing craftsmanship credentials, but the resume does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role. The requirement of 8 years of C++ programming is far from met — C/C++ appears in a single ~7-month role at National Instruments and a university thesis project. Similarly, there is limited evidence of large-scale distributed infrastructure ownership (the Sociomantic low-latency micro-services work is the closest match, in D, not C++), no formal technical leadership or team lead title, and no production cloud compute platform architecture experience beyond AWS CDK application work and Kubernetes deployments for a personal project. Strong mentoring/teaching signal via workshops and courses is a plus, but not enough to offset the fundamental technical mismatch.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ years) across web, mobile, embedded, and systems work
Proven low-latency, high-throughput micro-services work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby (millions of req/s)
Strong mentoring and knowledge-sharing track record via workshops, courses, conference talks, and OSS
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~7 months) versus the 8-year minimum requirement
No formal technical leadership role or evidence of leading cloud/DevOps engineers
Limited large-scale cloud compute platform architecture and distributed systems ownership
